messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: rstan 2.14.2 released
parts:
The next release of rstan has been on CRAN for several days and has binary packages for Windows and OSX. There was no release of the Stan library, algorithms, etc. Not much changed, except rstan should crash less when using stan() or sampling() in weird loops

https://github.com/stan-dev/rstan/blob/develop/rstan/rstan/inst/NEWS

Ben
